## Uncovered or only partly coverable

Every Plan d'études objective and content item has at least one template.

Items that a screen-based app can train only partly (honest limits): GC.3 (communicating — the app trains reading and choosing arguments, not oral exchange between pupils); EF.1.4 and EF.2.11 (drawing by hand and with a set square/compass — the app trains the geometric decisions, not the motor skill); EF.2.9 (tracing angles with a real protractor — measuring on screen is trained); GM.2.1 (estimating real quantities in the classroom). MT.90 (scatterplot of two linear equations) is cycle 4.2 and deliberately left out.
